purpose: Durable queue for sanitized reusable lessons discovered during client or methodology execution without interrupting the active methodology cursor.

observations.title: Multi-environment working-plane topology
observations.origin_context: Management governance review exposed that provider-level working-plane assumptions can misclassify evidence and architecture.
observations.sanitized_observation: Organizations may legitimately operate across multiple providers, tenants, environments, services, and locations. Provider name alone is not sufficient environment identity or evidence provenance.
observations.evidence_needed: Use in at least one multi-tenant or multi-provider organization outside the originating field laboratory.

observations.title: Maturity-adaptive connected discovery
observations.origin_context: Discovery design showed that mature process corpora can shortcut system-by-system discovery while low-documentation organizations may benefit from optional authorized connector review.
observations.sanitized_observation: 10XP discovery should choose the least intrusive acquisition path: corpus intake, corpus plus targeted validation, targeted connected read, or broader authorized connected discovery. Connector access accelerates evidence collection but does not create authority.
observations.evidence_needed: Run the acquisition profiles across organizations with materially different process maturity and compare discovery cost, accuracy, and validation burden.

observations.title: Terminology drift requires semantic crosswalk before renaming
observations.origin_context: Adjacent service work used different terms for apparently similar operating concepts.
observations.sanitized_observation: Cross-team integration should map terminology semantically before changing durable source vocabulary. Similar labels require comparison of definition, object boundary, lifecycle, authority, fields, and relationships.
observations.evidence_needed: Validate during at least one multi-team or cross-organization integration with real terminology collisions.

observations.title: Methodology learning requires a parallel durable observation queue
observations.origin_context: Several material method improvements existed only in conversation while the formal methodology cursor remained on unrelated M04 work.
observations.sanitized_observation: Method learning should be captured immediately without hijacking the active methodology-development cursor. A durable observation queue allows capture now and triage later.
observations.evidence_needed: Demonstrate repeated client-to-method capture cycles without lost insights or disruptive cursor switching.

observations.title: Role transitions require explicit routing, durable context transfer, and authority-preserving conflict resolution
observations.origin_context: A governed role transition showed that correct successor-role routing and correct context transfer are separate control problems. The runtime guard already defined the correct routing outcome, but the method lacked a generic durable handoff object describing which shared facts, source pointers, assumptions, dependencies, and authority boundaries may cross into the receiving role.
observations.sanitized_observation: When material work crosses governed roles, 10XP should separate execution routing, context transfer, and authority resolution. The Next-Step Contract identifies the destination conversation/role; a compact durable Role Handoff Contract identifies authoritative sources, shared facts, unresolved assumptions, dependencies, authority limits, and the receiving task. The handoff transfers context rather than authority. Sending-role recommendations remain non-binding; disagreements resolve first from authoritative sources, then through the owning domain, with valid human escalation reserved for genuine authority/adoption conflicts.
observations.evidence_needed: Use the Role Handoff Contract across additional material role transitions and test whether zero-context receiving roles can start safely, challenge non-binding upstream context without authority leakage, route domain conflicts correctly, and escalate only genuine authority/adoption disputes without creating unnecessary human bottlenecks.
observations.refinement_note: Implemented authority firewall: role titles do not create cross-role override rights; handoff context is classified by source/authority; recipient conflicts follow source-resolvable -> domain-owned -> valid-human-authority escalation, while non-material professional disagreement does not require escalation.

rules: No material reusable methodology insight should remain conversation-only after a substantive batch.
Client-confidential evidence remains in the client environment; this register stores sanitized observations only.
The observation queue does not replace or automatically advance PROCESS_STATE.current_task_id.
